import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    s = data.lstrip('-+')
    if not s or not s.isdigit():
        print(0)
        return
    total = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i + 1 < n:
        total += abs(int(s[i]) - int(s[i + 1]))
        i += 2
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
